question: A journalist uses Claude to help draft portions of an article that will be published under the news outlet's byline. Under Anthropic's Usage Policy guidance for high-risk journalistic content, what is required?
options: A) The journalist must obtain a signed release from Anthropic for each article that includes any AI-assisted content.
B) The outlet must apply appropriate human editorial review and disclosure practices regarding AI involvement before publication.
C) The outlet must replace every AI-assisted sentence with fully original human-written text before the article can be published.
D) The journalist may publish the AI-drafted sections without any additional review, since journalism is exempt from the high-risk category.
correct_answers: B) The outlet must apply appropriate human editorial review and disclosure practices regarding AI involvement before publication.
explanations: Incorrect. Anthropic does not require a per-article signed release; the obligation is editorial review and disclosure by the outlet.
Correct. Journalistic content requires human editorial review and appropriate disclosure of AI involvement before publication.
Incorrect. The policy requires editorial review and disclosure, not a blanket ban on any AI-assisted text appearing in the article.
Incorrect. Journalistic content generated for publication is treated as a high-risk use case, not an exempt category.
